items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I used to sit up with him all night, he and I, draft him with his guitars, and I'd take the bass over to his room.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was going to ask that.

Yeah, I see. He's pretty good. You see, he's the best one. And I made him get a guitar. I used to sit up with him all night when he was on band. See, I used to sit up with him all night, he and I, draft him with his guitars, and I'd take the bass over to his room. We'd like to do that. I didn't put that one now, we'd make so much noise, he'd get the bass. Three or four o'clock in the morning. See? You get six string chords, the other guys are going to play a whole lot of melody.
